cover: Use case: illustration-story. Create a 3:1 README banner for open source project 'abap-tcmb-rates'. Reference 1 specifies approved dark plum #231A28, cream #F4F0E8, lime #D4E86A illustrated Cheditte style, bold sans-serif, outlined isometric objects with matte cream fronts and plum sides. Reference 2 supplied SAP logo is the ONLY corporate logo. Left half large title on two lines 'TCMB rates' and 'inside SAP'. Below exact 'One ABAP report.' and smaller 'Preview · Save · Schedule'. Bottom-left 'Cheditte / abap-tcmb-rates'. Right half a meaningful left-to-right sequence: a dimensional bulletin sheet labelled 'TCMB' with currency codes USD EUR JPY and neutral lines (no numeric rates), a lime arrow to a desktop monitor displaying a simple generic rate table, with supplied blue SAP logo directly above screen and small caption 'OB08'. A small clock beside monitor suggests scheduled runs. SAP logo has no backing badge. Bulletin is a generic document, do NOT invent a TCMB emblem or bank logo. Avoid trading candles, money bags, coins, growth charts, certification or fake test evidence. Sparse lavender grid only right. Safe margins and readable text. Corporate, modern, same family as reference but currency-import story instead of Jira server cards.
